Firefighter will participate in duties of protecting life and property and firefighting/rescue operations
q: Firefighter I and II, Airport Firefighter, CPR AHA or Red Cross, Hazmat Awareness, Hazmat Operation, NREMT-Basic, Tender Driver Operator, ARFF Operator and Confine Space Rescue.

d: Four Seasons is powered by our people. We are a collective of individuals who crave to become better, to push ourselves to new heights and to treat each other as we wish to be treated in return. Our team members around the world create amazing experiences for our guests, residents, and partners through a commitment to luxury with genuine heart. We know that the best way to enable our people to deliver these exceptional guest experiences is through a world-class employee experience and company culture.

At Four Seasons, we believe in recognizing a familiar face, welcoming a new one and treating everyone we meet the way we would want to be treated ourselves. Whether you work with us, stay with us, live with us or discover with us, we believe our purpose is to create impressions that will stay with you for a lifetime. On an exclusive island in the heart of the Kingdom’s capital, Four Seasons Hotel Bahrain Bay, with its unique architecture, has become an iconic landmark that soars as a destination in its own right, combining the best of a beach holiday and an urban getaway.

We are seeking a passionate and detail-oriented In-Room Dining Supervisor to join our team. This role is responsible for overseeing the daily operations of the In-Room Dining department, ensuring exceptional service standards, and creating memorable guest experiences.
q: We are looking for an individual who can delight guests by supervising the In-Room Dining experiences through a detailed and guest-focused perspective. You will receive guest requests and communicate directly with the team to deliver the best personal dining experience possible, taking action on guest needs, both expressed and unspoken. Intuition and articulation will be essential in successfully mastering the role.
2 years’ experience of relevant experience in a similar role within 5* luxury Hotel, Technical education in Hospitality management or service methods is preferred.
r: Responsible for supervising the day-to-day operations for the In Room Dining Department in absence of the Manager.
To work to ensure the consistency, quality and efficiency of food and beverage service and amenities for the hotel’s guest rooms & suites. To follow the wishes and preferences of our guests.

Answer telephone using courteous, efficient telephone etiquette. Take guest in-room dining orders. Communicate special requests to the kitchen. Coordinate and deliver of orders according to Four Seasons Standards. Respond and answer guests' requests and inquiries. Anticipate guest needs, ascertain satisfaction, and offer suggestions, and respond urgently and appropriately to guest concerns and requests.

d: The Outsourced Markets Lead leads Pfizer’s outsourcing operations to drive business growth across Public and Private channels in Oman / Bahrain / Iran.

The role develops the appropriate strategies and plans of action to achieve the short- and long-term objectives of the outsourcing operations, owning the total Oman / Bahrain / Iran business for the assigned outsourcing operations and ensuring the agreed sales growth is delivered in all three countries.
q: Minimum 10 years' experience in the pharmaceutical industry with a strong commercial/sales focus.
Proven country management experience, with end-to-end responsibility for commercial performance, cross-functional execution, partner governance and delivery of business objectives.
Experience in commercial operations and/or sales and marketing is a plus.
Experience in the Oman / Bahrain / Iran markets is strongly preferred.
Previous experience in a channel management model is a plus.
Demonstrated commercial and business acumen, with strong negotiation skills.
Ability to influence across stakeholders and lead without authority.
Demonstrated results leading in multi-cultural and matrix teams.

Proven experience managing complex markets remotely or across borders through distributors and local partners, with the ability to maintain market insight, governance and execution without continuous in-country presence.
Fluent in written and spoken English and Arabic.
Influence Without Authority Influences stakeholders without direct authority.
Structure & Process Introduces structure and process.
Reports to Outsourced Markets Director; works closely with the Outsourced Markets Operations Managers
Sales Intermediaries, Commercial Excellence, H&V, Marketing, Medical, PGSCE platform and Category Leads
Distributors and outsourcing partners in Oman / Bahrain / Iran

Operating model: Role leads the assigned Pfizer outsourcing operations in Oman / Bahrain / Iran across Public and Private channels through distributor partners, in collaboration with the Outsourcing Operations Managers and cross-functional teams.
Pfizer Gulf is an equal-opportunity employer, and we are proud of our commitment to creating a diverse and inclusive candidate pool to support and empower our workforce.

r: Lead and manage the total business of Oman / Bahrain / Iran for the assigned outsourcing operations and ensure the agreed sales growth is met in all three countries.
Develop the portfolio strategy for Oman / Bahrain / Iran, including portfolio prioritization, lifecycle opportunities, launches, loss-of-exclusivity risks, and resource allocation.
Hold operational responsibility for the assigned outsourcing operations, developing optimum commercial plans to maximize the growth potential and profit of Mature Brands.
Evaluate and propose all new countries sales opportunities in the Mature Brands portfolio.
Highlight and support opportunities for local partnerships in collaboration with the country Mature Brands Lead, proactively sharing market opportunities and risks.
Lead launch readiness and commercialization of priority portfolio opportunities, ensuring cross-functional alignment across regulatory, supply, access, medical and commercial activities.

Lead cross-functional alignment across Commercial, Marketing, Medical, Regulatory, Access, Finance, Legal, Compliance and Supply to translate market strategy into execution and deliver business objectives.

Lead complex and geographically dispersed markets remotely from another country, adapting the operating model to distinct regulatory, economic, access and partner environments while maintaining strong governance, local stakeholder engagement and timely decision-making.
Forecast and set the country’s sales budget of Pfizer outsourcing operations (sales and supply).
Monitor and control countries sales and operating expenses of outsourcing projects.
Proactively manage deviations from the countries sales plan to minimize downsides and maximize upside opportunities.

Regularly review the total scope of outsourcing projects from a financial and operational perspective to ensure effective management of resources and identify opportunities for continuous improvement.
Establish and manage appropriate metrics, KPIs and scorecards to measure performance, partnership health and achievement of goals and objectives.
Drive managerial decision-making, sales analysis, sales target setting and growth.
Drive revenue, profitability and resource allocation across the outsourced business, balancing growth with sustainable financial performance.
Create a customized follow-up system to oversee partner performance and motivate partners to accomplish sales objectives.
Follow up closely with distributors to ensure their commitment to contractual agreements.
Support the Commercial Excellence team in designing, amending and renewing distributor contracts.
Handle and resolve all sales issues related to Pfizer outsourcing projects.
Build distributor and partner capabilities through structured performance reviews, coaching, capability development and clear improvement plans to strengthen execution and business performance.
Own and coordinate pricing, reimbursement, access and affordability strategies across public and private channels.
Lead the tender coordination process for outsourcing operations with all stakeholders.
Manage local inventories and liaise with Production and Distribution Planning.
Coordinate with commercial teams and PGS to ensure an up-to-date demand forecast and reliable supply.
Ensure the development and engagement of outsourcing team members and collaborate with the Outsourcing markets operations to implement the agreed plan of action.
Own performance management, reporting, and standardized policies and procedures for the outsourcing operations.
Continuously assess market dynamics, competitor activity, channel evolution and customer insights, translating them into commercial actions.

Establish appropriate governance and oversight of outsourcing partners to proactively identify and mitigate compliance, financial, operational and reputational risks, ensuring activities are conducted in line with Pfizer policies and applicable local regulations.
Owns the countries sales budget, commercial plans, KPIs and partner follow-up for the assigned outsourcing operations within delegated authority.
Proposes new Mature Brands opportunities, local partnerships and distributor contract designs, amendments or renewals for approval.
Escalates decisions outside delegated authority, including material supply, compliance, financial or reputational risks.

d: We’re hiring: Sales Executive, Bin Salman Lighting & Electricals (Muscat)

At BSL we design and supply lighting for villas, homes and projects across Oman. We don’t win by being the cheapest. We win because we believe in what we sell and because clients trust the service behind it.
We’re looking for a Sales Executive who sells the same way.
This role is for you if
You sell with conviction, not by begging or cutting prices
People listen to you in a meeting, and you get your confidence from knowing your product well
You’d rather visit a designer’s office than wait for the phone to ring
You take ownership: when a client trusts you, you follow through all the way to handover
r: Map the market: find upcoming villas, buildings and fit-out projects before they go to tender
Build relationships with interior designers, architects, MEP consultants and contractors
Apply for tenders and prepare complete, accurate submissions
Learn our product range quickly and turn drawings and BOQs into clear quotations
Present our lighting concepts to clients alongside our design team
Keep your pipeline organised and follow up until the deal is closed
3–5 years minimum in B2B, project or specification sales (lighting, MEP, building materials or interiors is a strong plus)
Strong Arabic and English, spoken and written
Comfortable using AI tools such as ChatGPT or Claude in everyday work: drafting proposals, researching projects, summarising tender documents, preparing client follow-ups
Valid Omani driving licence and willingness to be in the field
A boutique company where your results are visible and credited to you
Direct work with the owner, with no layers of management
Products you can be proud to present
Room to grow as the company grows
This role is not for you if you’re looking for a desk job, or if you believe the only way to close a deal is a bigger discount.

To apply, email your CV to hamza@bsalman.com with the subject “Sales Executive”, plus 3–4 lines answering this question: “Tell us about a deal you closed without lowering the price. How did you win it?”
Applications without this answer won’t be reviewed.

d: Binance is a leading global blockchain ecosystem behind the world’s largest cryptocurrency exchange by trading volume and registered users. We are trusted by 300+ million people in 100+ countries for our industry-leading security, user fund transparency, trading engine speed, deep liquidity, and an unmatched portfolio of digital-asset products. Binance offerings range from trading and finance to education, research, payments, institutional services, and more. Our mission is to increase the freedom of money and financial access for people around the world.
q: Fluency in English is required to be able to coordinate with overseas partners and stakeholders. Additional languages would be an advantage.
6+ years of digital marketing experience in social media, content or brand marketing related roles.
Hands-on experience using AI tools to produce content across static visuals, GIFs, memes and short-form video, with examples of measurable impact.
Demonstrated ability to grow social media accounts and execute campaigns.
Good understanding of the crypto market, with an interest in staying current on trends and sentiment, and familiarity with Binance's product suite.
Strong knowledge of content creation and social media channels, with X, Instagram, and TikTok as a top priority.
Experience supporting marketing campaigns and working with external agencies, partners, or creators is a plus.
Comfortable with analytics and reporting tools; strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment.
Collaborate with world-class talent in a user-centric global organization with a flat structure
Tackle challenging projects in a fast-paced and innovative enviornment with autonomy
Thrive in a results-driven workplace with opportunities for career growth and continuous learning
Remote-first, work-from-home arrangement (may vary depending on the nature of the role and team)

Strong knowledge of video-first social platforms, particularly TikTok and Instagram, including short-form video formats, audience behaviors, platform algorithms, and best practices for driving reach, engagement, and channel growth through engaging, culturally relevant content.
Support the growth of leadership profiles through channel strategy, content development, daily page management, and ongoing optimization.
Stay ahead of emerging social media trends, identifying opportunities to translate them into relevant, engaging ideas that deliver value for the brand.
Develop creative, culturally relevant ideas that turn social trends into standout moments and meaningful brand impact.
Lead coordination with agencies and external partners to ensure content deliverables meet agreed timelines, quality standards, and brand objectives.
Support the execution of integrated marketing campaigns, product launches, and community activation initiatives.

Coordinate with cross-functional stakeholders to align content schedules, maintain consistent messaging, and ensure timely delivery across channels.
Monitor social sentiment and emerging issues, escalating potential risks and supporting crisis communication plans led by senior team members and Global Communications.
Track, analyze, and report on social media and community performance weekly and monthly, using existing analytics tools and data to identify opportunities for improvement.
